node.statement: By node 1.2.3, the first summand in the displayed telescope has cb norm at most (1+C_theta)*eta. By nodes 1.2.4 and 1.2.5 plus cb-norm submultiplicativity, the second has cb norm at most (C_Delta+C_L)*eta*2. The triangle inequality and C_Upsilon'=1+C_theta+2*C_Delta+2*C_L from (1.3) prove the stated bound.
